newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel mutual funds' assets up 5.2 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Israel mutual funds' assets up 5.2 pct in May.

text.p: Israeli mutual funds' assets in May rose 5.2 percent to 16.71 billion shekels from 15.88 billion in April, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report released on Wednesday.
Meitav attributed the increase to the funds' average positive yields of 3.5 percent in May as well as an inflow of 310 million shekels into funds investing in unlinked bonds.
Equity funds, for the first time in several months, attracted 85 million shekels in new money, Meitav said. There were redemptions in other types of government bond funds and foreign currency funds.
Overall, there was a net inflow of 274 million shekels into mutual funds in May.
